svg.title: From a picture file to the screen
svg.desc: How one picture, the grassland battle backdrop, gets into the game. It is kept as an ordinary picture file, grassland.png, whose pixels are numbers into its own list of 128 colours. The build packs it into the two forms the game reads: the list of colours, and the pixels, compressed. A small assembly file places both on the cartridge under the name the code uses, Battle_GrasslandBackdrop, and the resource directory gives it a number. A battle on the world map's grassland, and the credits, ask for it by that number.
svg.text: ONE PICTURE: THE GRASSLAND BATTLE BACKDROP
each pixel a number into its own 128 colours
its row in the resource directory
by a battle on the world map's grassland,
